title: Digital identity, IT modernization and procurement feature in California’s new budget
summary: California's $351.7 billion budget for the coming fiscal year continues spending on numerous major technology projects already underway.

title: Idaho CIO appointed state transportation director
summary: Alberto Gonzalez, who's been serving as Idaho's chief information officer for nearly four years, will take a new role as the state's transportation director.

title: State, local cyber grant funding can’t be used on ‘bundled’ services from membership groups, FEMA clarifies
summary: The Federal Emergency Management Agency has clarified that state and local governments can use federal cyber grant funding to pay for services from membership organizations, provided they aren't "bundled."

title: Dallas to distribute ID-tags to help owners find lost pets and reduce pressure on city shelters
summary: Dallas Animal Services has launched a six-month pilot program that aims to reunite more lost pets with their owners.

title: Water utility cyber upgrades, digital literacy among Florida budget cuts
summary: Florida Gov. Ron DeSantis vetoed $1.6 billion in projects, including technology projects, from the state's new budget.

title: Pennsylvania selects RTA to modernize fleet management software
summary: State officials said the software upgrade will "help standardize processes across agencies” and allow the state to more efficiently deploy its thousands of fleet vehicles.

title: California agencies get access to Anthropic’s AI tools at half price
summary: California agencies will be able to use Anthropic's tools at half cost, to streamline administrative work, analyze large volumes of information, draft documents and improve constituent services.

title: The high cost of last-minute election overhauls
summary: For technical teams and election administrators, redrawing a congressional map is far more complicated than moving a line on a screen.

title: State, local governments can do more to safeguard LGBTQ+ data under Trump
summary: A new report claims states and local governments can do more to safeguard LGBTQ+ data in the face of hostile federal policies, including expanding data collection.

title: Advocacy groups call FCC’s E-Rate review an ‘attack’ on schools and libraries
summary: The FCC has initiated a broad review of the federal E-Rate program, opening the possibility for it to be limited or even terminated.
